title: 第13章 神凰精血第14章 求求你了跟我回去好不好
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 天妖峡。
山洞之中。
“我这是”
也不知道昏迷了多久，等楚尘睁开眼睛时，天空刚刚破晓。
金色的阳光穿透头顶上茂密的灌木丛，从洞口斜射进来，直直地打在楚尘的脸上，让他醒后不自觉地揉了揉双眼，神情恍惚。
“流了这么多血都没死，也没被妖兽闯进来吃了，我楚尘的命还真是大！！”
低头看了看已然结出血痂的伤口，还有洞口泛著微光的阵法，楚尘一阵后怕。
不得不说，太冒险了！
吞天魔罐可是一尊极道帝兵，即便是被封禁的帝兵，那炼化过程也极其凶险。
再者从侍女蝶儿处抢来的储物戒指中，所藏阵法都是最低品阶的，寻常妖兽还能蒙蔽一二，若是遇到开天秘境以上的妖兽，这些防御和隱匿气息的阵法，形同虚设。
不过好在此处是天妖峡外围，那些实力强大的妖兽一般都有自己的领地，除非遭受威胁，轻易不会外出。
“大难不死，必有后福。”
楚尘一招手，一个通体漆黑的瓦罐凭空出现在面前，垂落下一缕又一缕乌光，无尽大道之力奔涌袭来。
罐体朴实自然，其貌不扬。
陶製的罐身如同一位妙龄少女的仙躯，散发著令诸天万界都战慄的恐怖威压，镇压九天十地。
罐口被刻下一道又一道恐怖到了极点的剑痕，即便还未靠近，凌厉的大罗剑意好似要撕裂此方苍穹，割裂天地。
楚尘一口鲜血喷出，连忙收拢心神，不敢再体会那些铭刻在罐身上的恐怖剑痕。
以他现在的修为和实力，再看下去，必被那残留的大罗剑意绞杀成灰。
“虽是初步炼化，但到底也算是炼化了这尊极道帝兵。”
楚尘擦了擦嘴角溢出的鲜血，满脸期待的捧著手里的吞天魔罐，这是他唯一的底牌。
能不能活著横穿天妖峡。
能不能顺利抵达神焰帝宫。
能不能成功见到女帝林书望
全繫於此。
content_en:
Tianyao Gorge.
In the cave.
"This is what I am"
He didn't know how long he had been unconscious. When Chu Chen opened his eyes, the sky had just broken.
The golden sunlight penetrated the dense bushes above his head, slanted in from the entrance of the cave, and hit Chu Chen's face directly, causing him to unconsciously rub his eyes after waking up, looking dazed.
"I lost so much blood and didn't die, and I didn't get eaten by monsters. I, Chu Chen, am really lucky!!"
Chu Chen was frightened for a moment when he lowered his head and looked at the wound that was covered with bleeding scabs and the shimmering formation at the hole.
I have to say, it’s too adventurous!
The Sky-Swallowing Magic Jar is an extremely powerful imperial weapon. Even if it is a banned imperial weapon, the refining process is extremely dangerous.
Furthermore, the formations hidden in the storage ring snatched from the maid Die'er are all of the lowest grade, which can deceive ordinary monsters. If you encounter monsters above the Kaitian Secret Realm, these defensive and aura-concealing formations are useless.
Fortunately, this is the outskirts of Tianyao Gorge. Those powerful monsters usually have their own territory and will not go out unless they are threatened.
"If you survive a catastrophe, you will be blessed later."
Chu Chen waved his hand, and a pitch-black earthen jar appeared in front of him out of thin air, with wisps of black light falling down, and the power of the endless avenue rushed towards him.
The jar body is simple and natural, and its appearance is not impressive.
The body of the pottery jar is like the fairy body of a young girl, exuding a terrifying pressure that makes all the heavens and worlds tremble, suppressing the nine heavens and ten earths.
The mouth of the jar was carved with extremely terrifying sword marks one after another. Even before he got close, the sharp sword intent of Daluo seemed to tear the sky and split the world.
"Poof!!"
Chu Chen spurted out a mouthful of blood and quickly gathered his mind, not daring to experience the terrifying sword marks engraved on the jar's body.
With his current cultivation and strength, if he continues any further, he will be strangled to ashes by the remaining Daluo Sword Intent.
"Although it is preliminary refining, in the end it can be regarded as refining this Supreme Dao Emperor Weapon."
Chu Chen wiped the blood that overflowed from the corner of his mouth, and held the Sky-Swallowing Devil Jar in his hand with expectation on his face. This was his only trump card.
Can you cross the Tianyao Gorge alive?
Can we successfully reach the Divine Flame Emperor Palace?
Can you successfully meet the empress Lin Shuwang?
It all depends on this.
title_en: Chapter 13 Divine Phoenix Essence and Blood Chapter 14 Please, please go back with me, okay?
